turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, thanks for contacting AcmeBrands. How can I help you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I am looking at a cool pair of jeans, but I'm worried about how often they will need to be washed. Do you know how often that should happen?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sure, i'd be happy to help you out with that.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, thanks!

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Can I get your first name so I can better address you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Joyce

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks Joyce.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: If you are using our jeans normally, they should be washed around once a week. That's if you use them two or three times a week.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yeah, that sounds about right.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: We don't recommend washing more often than that, as it can dull the color.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Whew! My laziness won't affect the longevity of the jeans then.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Awesome! That's all I wanted to know. I appreciate your help.

turns.text: Not a problem, that's what we are here for! Is there anything else I can help you out with today?
